result.summary: Reviewed the full main...HEAD diff (48 files, +21/-2313 lines) removing the Tavus CVI video-calling integration and its Daily.co dependency, dispatching the review-code skill's full reviewer fleet (correctness, convention, tests, maintainability, agent-native, security, data-integrity) alongside manual verification of dangling references, lockfile/workspace consistency, CSP/Permissions-Policy correctness, Convex codegen freshness, and directory deletions. The removal is thorough and self-consistent: no dangling imports, props, env vars, or Convex query/validator references anywhere in the tree; the previously-flagged unauthenticated-Tavus-route security concern (canceled ticket FG_012) is now moot since the route is deleted entirely; CSP/Permissions-Policy correctly drop camera/microphone/Daily.co/tavusapi.com while retaining what surviving features (e.g. Convex-hosted cover video) still need; and all associated tests were updated or removed consistently with passing suites. The single surviving finding is a P3/nit: `.claude/health.md` and `.agents/health.md` still describe `apps/mirror/AGENTS.md` as "Current" while citing "video-call features added," which this same PR just removed from AGENTS.md — filed as ISSUE-7. Harness-reported `bun run typecheck` failure is a pre-existing repo gap (no `typecheck` script exists anywhere in the monorepo, on main or this branch) unrelated to this diff.
